text:
Maya: Quick ask — need to capture full request+response bodies for a PROD rerank failure to reproduce. Will be ephemeral (48h) and stored under s3://redwood-debug/ephemeral/2639876543/. Trace: trace_id=abc123. No Authorization headers will be captured. @security-oncall can we get provisional OK?
Samir: Do we need full user PII? can we pseudonymize/email-hash? sampling would also help.
Maya: We tried hashing user_id but model behavior differs — the prompt context matters (names/phrases). Need raw prompt + model response to reproduce the bug.
Elena: Ok clarifying q: are tokens/logit-levels included? any attachments? Also who exactly will access the bucket?
Maya: No token-level logs, just request/response text fields and metadata keys: trace_id, request_id, timestamp. Access limited to eng/infra-debug + the oncall. I'll create ENG-4567 for audit.
Dmitri-Sec: Security POV: we can approve with conditions:
 - retention = 48 hours, auto-delete enforced
 - bucket path s3://redwood-debug/ephemeral/2639876543/ with server-side encryption and no public ACLs
 - PII fields (email, phone, ssn) must be HMAC'd with redwood-debug-key before storage
 - access via iam role eng-debug-only, no cross-account access
 - ACL + object-level audit logs enabled
Once those are in place, @security-oncall will sign off.
Maya: I can HMAC on ingest. Example command to copy test sample for devs:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/sample.json s3://redwood-debug/ephemeral/2639876543/sample.json --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/redwood-debug-key
```
Elena: Please file ENG-4567 and add the encryption + IAM PR. @security-oncall ping when done. :thumbsup:
security-oncall: provisional ok pending ticket + PR. Keep us looped. I'll approve in the ticket when IAM + KMS policies attached.
Maya: Thanks — will open ticket + PR, will post deletion confirmation once 48h lapse.
